questions.q: Arrange following compounds in decreasing order of reactivity for hydrolysis reaction

Reactivity $∝$ electron deficiency at C-atom of $- CO$ group
or Reactivity $∝ \dfrac{1}{Stabilityofpolarstructure}$
Thus electron withdrawing group increases reactivity and electron donating group decreases reactivity.
